solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: What a well-organised discounter can give?

definitions.text: What a well-organised discounter can give?

indicators.note: the letters of discounter, once organised well into a new order, make a fresh word

explanation.surface: A shop that sells at a discount, run efficiently, can offer customers money off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well-organised' signals that DISCOUNTER is rearranged; the whole clue then describes what a discounter offers.
explanation.definitionFit: Price cuts are exactly what a discount seller hands its customers.

clue.text: Set up right sensing device

parts.note: the ear is an organ for sensing sound

explanation.surface: Install the correct sensor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set up' looks like an instruction to install; it is the definition, to raise.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise children or lift something upright is to bring it up.

clue.text: Cut in power reversed consumption?

indicators.note: in means the power letter sits inside the cut synonym

parts.note: a cut in a text is a deletion

explanation.surface: A power cut was undone, reversing energy use.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts P inside DELETION. 'reversed' does no work in the wordplay: P reads the same either way, so the setter's reversal of it changes nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Using up stocks reduces them, a kind of consumption.

clue.text: Base is not removed from damaged cenotaph

indicators.note: damaged means broken up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the word not gives the letters taken away

explanation.surface: The base of a damaged war memorial has not been taken away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' rearranges CENOTAPH; 'removed' says the letters N, O, T are taken out of it, leaving the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Low and vulgar, base things are of poor quality.

clue.text: Sexual reproduction is, with love, lively

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
gamy can mean spirited or plucky

explanation.surface: Reproduction is a lively business when love is involved.
explanation.walkthrough: Love is O as a nil score in tennis.
explanation.definitionFit: Reproduction by fusion of two similar gametes is a form of sexual reproduction.

clue.text: Final part of mountain climb is beginning to develop

indicators.note: final part means the last letter of mountain

parts.note: an ascent is a climb

explanation.surface: The final stretch of the mountain climb is just starting.
explanation.definitionFit: Emerging and just coming into being describes something newly forming.

clue.text: Horse breeding establishment curtailed research

indicators.note: curtailed means having its tail cut off, so the last letter of the synonym goes

parts.note: to research a topic is to study it

explanation.surface: A stable of breeding horses had its scientific work cut short.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curtailed' drops the final Y from STUDY.
explanation.definitionFit: A farm where stallions are kept for breeding is called by this name.

clue.text: The stock is all lacking in weight

indicators.note: in means the shortened word goes inside the weight

parts.note: a ton is a unit of weight

indicators.note: lacking means the word all is short of its last letter

explanation.surface: Every share in the company is underweight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' trims the last letter and 'in' marks the container. In card games such as patience, the stock is the pile left after dealing.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games, the pile of cards left undealt is called this.

clue.text: Record, unsuccessful, is revealing

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
unsuccessful means losing

explanation.surface: A flop of a record exposes all.
explanation.definitionFit: Making something known, or exposing it, is revealing it.

clue.text: Ministerial history not written down

parts.note: history is the past
oral means spoken, not written

explanation.surface: A government minister's record was never put on paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ministerial' suggests government, but it means relating to a church minister's care.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergy minister's work caring for the flock is of this kind.

clue.text: Topped and tailed specimens should be large enough

indicators.note: losing top and tail means the first and last letters of the synonym are removed

parts.note: specimens are samples taken for testing

explanation.surface: Trimmed test specimens should still be big enough for analysis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Topped and tailed' removes the outer S at each end of SAMPLES.
explanation.definitionFit: Plenty, or sufficient in quantity, is what this adjective means.

clue.text: Drunken constable is not counting in bars

indicators.note: drunken suggests staggering disorder, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: the word in is the part not counted among the letters

explanation.surface: An intoxicated police officer is barred from the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drunken' shuffles CONSTABLE and IS; 'not counting' says the letters of IN are left out of that pool, leaving the answer's letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Barriers and hindrances are both things that block the way, as bars do.

clue.text: Model employee who sometimes arrives behind schedule

parts.note: a temp is a temporary employee
arriving behind schedule means arriving late

explanation.surface: The ideal worker is a stand-in who occasionally turns up late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Model' looks like praise for the worker, but it is the definition: a pattern to copy.
explanation.definitionFit: A pattern or guide used as the basis for copies is a model.

clue.text: Alto changed around end of hymn according to key

indicators.note: around means the shuffled letters surround the next piece
changed means the letters of alto are put in a different order
the end of hymn is its final letter

explanation.surface: A choir's alto part was altered around the close of a hymn to fit the key.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' rearranges ALTO to TOAL, and 'around' puts N, from 'end of hymn', inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Music written in a particular key, with a home note, is described this way.

clue.text: Member covered building store?

explanation.surface: A covered limb builds up supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: A leg wearing hosiery pulled on is covered; building store means gathering supplies in.

clue.text: Set of dramatic works, and one journal, cited in essay

indicators.note: cited in means mentioned within, so these letters sit inside the essay synonym

parts.note: an essay is an attempt, a try
one is I, the Roman numeral
a log is a journal or record

explanation.surface: An essay discusses a set of plays and quotes one magazine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cited in' marks the container. Essay here is the old sense of an attempt, not a piece of writing.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of three related plays or novels forms a single sequence.

clue.text: Exotic introduction to odes and poetry, for instance

indicators.note: introduction means the first letter of odes

parts.note: verse is poetry
as can mean for instance, as in such as

explanation.surface: Exotic openings to odes and poems are an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Foreign, from abroad, is a sense shared with exotic.

clue.text: Lab animal, running back, achieves objectives

indicators.note: running back means the animal's letters are read from the end to the start

parts.note: a rat is a common laboratory animal
to achieve something is to get it

explanation.surface: A lab rat scurries backwards and reaches its goals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running back' reverses the animal; 'Lab' tempts towards dogs (labradors), but a rat is the lab animal here.
explanation.definitionFit: Aims or goals are what one sets out to hit.

clue.text: They draw out loving in preparation for sex

indicators.note: in means the loving synonym sits inside the shuffled letters
a preparation is a mixing up, so the letters of sex are rearranged

parts.note: tender means loving

explanation.surface: Tender foreplay before sex is drawn out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'preparation for' signals the anagram, giving EXS, and 'in' marks the container; the racy surface hides plain lengtheners.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that lengthen or prolong are extenders, as they draw out.

clue.text: Parts of bloc, once defeated, give up?

indicators.note: parts of several words means the letters are taken across them

explanation.surface: Members of a political bloc, once beaten, may surrender.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run through 'bloC ONCE DEfeated'.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit defeat or yield is to give up.

clue.text: Hacker uploaded explosive research

indicators.note: uploaded means sent upwards, which in a down clue reads the word from bottom to top

parts.note: an axe hacks wood
a mine is an explosive device

explanation.surface: A computer hacker posts explosive findings online.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hacker' looks like a computer criminal; it is a chopping tool. 'uploaded' turns AXE to EXA.
explanation.definitionFit: To investigate or study something closely is to inspect it.

clue.text: Pedallers primarily set in one formation?

definitions.text: Pedallers primarily set in one formation?

indicators.note: primarily means first, so only the opening letter of Pedallers is used
in means the set synonym goes inside the rearranged letters
a formation is an arrangement, so the letters of one are rearranged

parts.note: a lot is a set or batch

explanation.surface: Cyclists, mainly, ride bunched together in a single group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'primarily' takes the first letter; 'formation' rearranges to EON and 'in' marks the container. The whole clue also describes the cycling pack.
explanation.definitionFit: In road racing, the main bunch of riders travelling together is this pack.

clue.text: Team-mate opening up after typical score

indicators.note: after means the reversed opening comes after the score

parts.note: par is the expected or typical golf score

indicators.note: up means the word is read upwards in a down clue, so backwards

parts.note: a rent is a tear, an opening

explanation.surface: A team-mate opens up after an average performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses the opening synonym, giving TNER, and 'after' sets it behind the golf score. Par is the score a good golfer is expected to make on a hole.
explanation.definitionFit: A colleague, or one of a pair, is a fellow member of a side.

clue.text: Computer displays one seen by kids

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral
to kid someone is to con them

explanation.surface: A computer screen is watched by children.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kids' looks like children but is a verb: deceives.
explanation.definitionFit: The small pictures on a screen that stand for programs are these symbols.

clue.text: Desert place unchanged under head of Oman

indicators.note: under means in a down clue that the second piece sits below the first
head means the first letter of Oman

parts.note: as is means unchanged, as it stands

explanation.surface: A desert spot stays the same under the ruler of Oman.
explanation.definitionFit: A fertile spot with water in a desert is a refuge.

clue.text: I am restricted by a friend with ill feeling

indicators.note: restricted by means held within, so these letters go inside the others

parts.note: a crony is a close friend
I am contracts to I'm

explanation.surface: I'm held back by a pal with resentment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'restricted by' marks the container: the contraction sits between the second and third letters of the friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitterness and rancour are forms of ill feeling.

clue.text: Apparatus for measuring oxygen extracted from heavenly body

indicators.note: extracted from means taken out of the heavenly body

parts.note: a meteor is a heavenly body
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A gauge measures oxygen drawn from a heavenly body.
explanation.definitionFit: A gauge or measuring instrument, US spelling of the device.

clue.text: Get rid of storage unit

explanation.surface: Clear out the storage space.
explanation.definitionFit: To cast off is to get rid of; a garden hut is a storage unit.

clue.text: Development, for example, set back transport hub

indicators.note: set back means the abbreviation is reversed, read from end to start

parts.note: a railway station is a transport hub

explanation.surface: A railway terminal's development has been delayed, for instance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set back' reverses the abbreviation, giving GE; 'set' is not a separate piece here.
explanation.definitionFit: The period of growth in the womb before birth is a time of development.

clue.text: Golfer's equipment reduced the power

parts.note: a tee is the peg a golfer places the ball on

indicators.note: reduced means cut short, so the word the loses its last letter

explanation.surface: A golfer's kit has cut down the strength of the drive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced' cuts THE to TH.
explanation.definitionFit: A law with real force is said to have bite, hence this word for power.

clue.text: Evidence of infection identified by hospital's enterprising effort

parts.note: pus forms in an infected wound
H is the abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: Hospital staff spot signs of infection through a bold initiative.
explanation.definitionFit: A drive or vigorous attempt is a determined effort.

clue.text: Blunder admitted by editors oddly caused great fear

indicators.note: admitted by means let inside, so the blunder sits within the other letters
oddly means strangely, so the letters of editors are jumbled

parts.note: to blunder is to err

explanation.surface: A mistake let slip by strange newspaper editors spread panic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' is the anagram signal, not alternate letters: the jumble gives TORISED, and 'admitted by' marks the container, the blunder going in after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To frighten people badly is to fill them with dread.
